texts:
Paste a web address and walk through it.

Portal reads the real page: each section becomes a building sized by what it says, each link becomes a door you step through.

three.ws/portal

This is the Three.js Wikipedia article, rebuilt as a place. The minimap is the site structure.

Walk into a door and you travel to that page, rebuilt as its own world.
Download the world as a GLB, or embed it on your own site. It is a real scene, not a screenshot.
